kind_note: Test-time reinforcement learning method (training algorithm applied per problem) from the paper "Learning to Discover at Test Time"; not a shipped model or product.
note: Lab note is roughly right: first author Mert Yuksekgonul, with coauthors from Stanford, NVIDIA, UC San Diego, Together AI and others (last author Yu Sun). Kind note 'harness' is wrong: TTT-Discover updates the model's weights with RL during each problem, which makes it a training algorithm rather than an agent harness or orchestration system, so release_basis is none_exists. The quoted sentence is the arXiv posting date of the paper (v1, 22 Jan 2026), which I record for context only; it is not a product release date. Code is at https://github.com/test-time-training/discover (linked from the arXiv comments field). The paper is listed as an ICML 2026 spotlight; the arXiv page was opened directly, and third-party summaries (hyper.ai, VentureBeat) agree on January 2026. Results use the open gpt-oss-120b model via Tinker.
queries: arXiv 2601.16175 "Learning to Discover at Test Time" submitted January 2026
